name: The Velvet Hours
heroText: Warm analog R&B for late nights and slow mornings. New single «Velvet Fever» out now.
about: Formed in 2021, The Velvet Hours are a three-piece blending the polished glow of ’80s sophisti-pop with the warmth and pulse of modern R&B. Their sound pairs intimate vocals and rich harmonies with warm analog textures and a soft, vinyl-dusted edge. Made for late nights and slow mornings, their songs feel both timeless and quietly close. Their latest album, Golden Static, is out now.
